'''Coson Pero''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a brother, [[Rels Pero]]. At some point, they helped [[Sona Fey'lya]] to take back the ''[[Blue Flare]]'', her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], to [[Logron]].
